During a camera-rail test I ran, I confirmed that the rotating platform in the current draft would enter the camera lane's required three-meter exclusion zone. The technically approved layout actually requires a fixed platform with a three-meter camera lane, not a rotating platform with a two-meter lane. I recorded this in the technical log but haven't yet updated Mara's design draft, so the draft you're all looking at still shows the incompatible configuration.
